oneLiner: A re-entry dashboard that tells PMs exactly where each project stands the moment they switch back to it.
problem: PMs juggling multiple projects lose critical context every time they switch, spending the first 10-15 minutes reconstructing what happened, who's blocked, and who's waiting on them instead of actually moving work forward.
targetUser: Product managers or team leads simultaneously running 3+ active projects who context-switch multiple times a day
coreFlow: PM lands on a project switcher showing all active projects with at-a-glance status flags
PM selects a project to re-enter
Dashboard surfaces the re-entry summary: last decision made, current blockers, and who's waiting on what
PM drills into a blocker or decision for more context if needed
PM takes action (unblock someone, log a new decision, reply to a waiting party) directly from the summary
PM marks context as 'caught up' before switching to the next project

screens.name: Project Switcher
screens.purpose: Give a bird's-eye view of all active projects with quick health/status indicators so the PM can prioritize where to re-enter

screens.name: Re-entry Summary
screens.purpose: Show the last decision made, active blockers, and who's waiting on what for the selected project — the core 'catch me up' view

screens.name: Decision Log
screens.purpose: Provide a chronological history of key decisions on the project so the PM can trace how the current state was reached

screens.name: Blocker Detail
screens.purpose: Show specifics on a blocker: who's affected, why it's stuck, how long it's been open, and suggested next action

screens.name: Waiting-On Queue
screens.purpose: Aggregate everything waiting on the PM across all projects, so they can clear obligations before switching contexts

outOfScope: Full task/project management (replacing tools like Jira or Asana)
